What changes for the business.

For service businesses, shops and growing organisations whose current website is missing, dated or difficult to use on a phone.

Easy to understand

What a scoped build can include.

Final deliverables, exclusions, responsibilities and operating costs are recorded before a commitment.

  • Page structure and responsive design
  • Copy responsibilities agreed in the scope
  • Accessibility and browser checks
  • Privacy page and verified contact handoff
  • Hosting and analytics only where approved

Website packages.

These packages are a starting point. Final scope and quotation are confirmed after we understand the project.

Two consolidated revision rounds are included. Additional agreed work is KES 3,000 per hour and quoted first. Timelines and commercial terms are confirmed in a written proposal.

Entry

KES 35,000

  • Five pages: home, services, about, contact and proof
  • Mobile-first design and verified contact handoff
  • Google Business Profile setup with supplied assets
  • Privacy page and year-one domain/hosting

Excludes extra copy, branding, media, ecommerce, payments, booking engine, eTIMS, apps, later edits, renewal, email hosting, SEO campaigns and ads.

Mid-tier

KES 65,000

  • Entry scope plus seven pages
  • Two service landing pages and copy for three pages
  • Tested quote or booking form and calendar link
  • First-month snapshot if analytics is approved

Excludes payments, eTIMS, catalogue/ecommerce, extra languages or training and later changes.

Premium

KES 95,000

  • Mid-tier scope plus ten pages
  • Branches and catalogue without cart
  • English and Kiswahili homepage
  • Up to 50 product entries and photo guidance

Excludes checkout, payments, stock integration, eTIMS, delivery tracking, multi-branch reporting and photography. Extra product entry is KES 3,000/hour.

How the work moves.

Each stage creates something you can review before the next decision.

Understand

Map the problem, current process and people responsible.

Build and test

Review the agreed scope with sample information and failure cases.

Prepare handover

Agree access, hosting, training, support and what remains outside scope.

Questions before a scope.

These answers state the current limits. A proposal records the project-specific terms.

Can you improve an existing website?

Yes. We first review what can be kept, what blocks customers and whether refinement or replacement is the sensible scope.

Is ecommerce included?

The Premium package includes a catalogue without cart. Checkout, payments, stock integration and delivery tracking need a separate scope.

Who supplies photos and branding?

The Entry package excludes branding, photography and video. We record who supplies every asset before work starts.

Start with the problem.

Describe what happens today and where work slows down. A live inquiry service will be introduced only after delivery and privacy controls are verified.
